# Enrolment templates for the admin plane (admin identity design §D1,
# "Break-glass and recovery"). Both are suspended with a schedule that never
# fires (31 February); they exist only to be instantiated by the operator:
#
#   kubectl -n vuoro-system create job <job-name> --from=cronjob/admin-enrol-template
#   kubectl -n vuoro-system create job <job-name> --from=cronjob/admin-enrol-break-glass-template
#
# The Job prints a single-use enrolment token (10 minutes) on stdout, so the
# finished Job and its pod are deleted after 15 minutes. backoffLimit 0: a
# retry would print a second token (and repeat a break-glass). The runbook
# (docs/runbooks/admin-plane.md, "Bootstrap enrolment") names each Job
# admin-enrol-<UTC timestamp>.
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: admin-enrol-template
  namespace: vuoro-system
spec:
  suspend: true
  schedule: "0 0 31 2 *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 0
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 900
      template:
        metadata: {labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vuoro-admin-enrol}}
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          serviceAccountName: vuoro-control-admin
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          imagePullSecrets: [{name: vuoro-ghcr-pull}]
          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65532, runAsGroup: 65532, fsGroup: 65532, seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}}
          containers:
            - name: admin-enrol
              image: ghcr.io/bayleafwalker/vuoro-cloud@sha256:02b792fdf2324ad56ea3ae7a85e82c348b88ae00894bc2991c678f5b065875bf
              command: [vuoro-admin-enrol]
              args: [--handle, operator]
              env:
                - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_SERVICE_ROLE, value: admin}
                - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT_ID, valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-control-runtime, key: VUORO_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT_ID}}}
                - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_DATABASE_URL, valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-control-admin-db, key: VUORO_CLOUD_DATABASE_URL}}}
                - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_TOKEN_PEPPER, valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-control-runtime, key: VUORO_CLOUD_TOKEN_PEPPER}}}
              resources: {requests: {cpu: 25m, memory: 64Mi}, limits: {cpu: 250m, memory: 256Mi}}
              securityContext: {allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: admin-enrol-break-glass-template
  namespace: vuoro-system
spec:
  suspend: true
  schedule: "0 0 31 2 *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 0
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 900
      template:
        metadata: {labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vuoro-admin-enrol}}
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          serviceAccountName: vuoro-control-admin
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          imagePullSecrets: [{name: vuoro-ghcr-pull}]
          securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65532, runAsGroup: 65532, fsGroup: 65532, seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}}
          containers:
            - name: admin-enrol
              image: ghcr.io/bayleafwalker/vuoro-cloud@sha256:02b792fdf2324ad56ea3ae7a85e82c348b88ae00894bc2991c678f5b065875bf
              command: [vuoro-admin-enrol]
              # Disables every credential of the admin, bumps its epoch and
              # revokes every refresh-token family before issuing the token.
              args: [--handle, operator, --break-glass]
              env:
                - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_SERVICE_ROLE, value: admin}
                - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT_ID, valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-control-runtime, key: VUORO_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT_ID}}}
                - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_DATABASE_URL, valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-control-admin-db, key: VUORO_CLOUD_DATABASE_URL}}}
                - {name: VUORO_CLOUD_TOKEN_PEPPER, valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: vuoro-control-runtime, key: VUORO_CLOUD_TOKEN_PEPPER}}}
              resources: {requests: {cpu: 25m, memory: 64Mi}, limits: {cpu: 250m, memory: 256Mi}}
              securityContext: {allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}
